verdict.rationale: Orrick offers digital self-service tools (Tech Studio forms, document generators, client portals), so asking whether they can be driven by a public API is a fair question. However, the evidence describes only browser-based, cookie-dependent interactive forms and portals, with no documented public API, developer docs, or programmatic access. The llms.txt probe also returned a 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
